summary: Kailera Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K to report amendments to its charter and bylaws effective upon the closing of its initial public offering. The amendments include increasing authorized common stock to 800 million shares, authorizing 10 million shares of undesignated preferred stock, establishing a classified board with staggered terms, requiring cause for director removal with a supermajority vote, and adopting exclusive forum provisions for certain legal actions. The filing is a routine post-IPO governance update, not a special situation event.
